observations: The official description frames each death as a restart of the journey.
The planet changes across cycles rather than presenting a fixed route every time.
Breaking the cycle is both the mechanical objective and the narrative question.
inferences: Generated variation is useful only if enough rule identity survives for earlier experience to guide the next run.
Death can carry narrative continuity without retaining every transient run object.
limits: The product page does not enumerate every persistent item, generation weight, or checkpoint rule.
Exact current balance requires build-specific play observation.
